questions.stem: Why are lipids good for long-term energy storage compared to carbohydrates?

options.text: Lipids are soluble in water so can be transported more easily
Lipids contain more energy per gram because they have a higher proportion of C-H bonds
Lipids are polymers so can be broken down faster
Lipids contain nitrogen which provides extra energy

questions.explanation: Lipids contain more energy per gram than carbohydrates because they have a higher proportion of carbon-hydrogen bonds, which release energy when oxidised. Lipids are also insoluble and compact.
